name: google-photos
description: Google Photos MCP server for Claude Code and AI agents. 26 tools for the photo picker, uploads, albums, enrichments, descriptions and app-created media.
long_description:
Connects Claude to Google Photos through the Picker API and the Library API.

Google removed whole-library read access from every third-party app on 31 March 2025, so the picker is the only route to a photo this server did not upload: it hands the user a Google-hosted URL, they choose, and Claude sees exactly what they chose. Everything else operates on media this server uploaded itself.

Setup is an OAuth client in a Google Cloud project you own, which takes about ten minutes once. Run `google-photos-mcp login` to turn the client id and secret into a refresh token, then paste all three below.

An upload cannot be undone: Google exposes no delete endpoint, so upload_from_url, upload_file, save_to_library and create_album_with_media wait for your approval.

client_id.title: OAuth client ID
client_id.description: From the Web application OAuth client in your own Google Cloud project. Ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com.

client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: The secret shown beside that client ID in the Google Cloud console.

refresh_token.title: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: Run `npx -y @thenavidm/google-photos-mcp-cli auth` with the two values above set, approve in the browser, and paste what it prints. Treat it like a password.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that can upload, create an album or write a description.
